chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Sludge Spinner, then Water's Edge on Sludge Spinner, then Coral Guard. This used all 3 energy, dealt 15 damage, applied Hydro with each damage card, and gained 5 Block.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Watatsumi Levy with Coral Guard or with one damage card because it could spend 6 Charge and Muster 2, but I rejected it because Muster transforms two cards already in hand into random Inazuma Companion cards, replacing known value with unknown cards.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up playing Watatsumi Levy, so it did not spend 6 Charge and did not generate any random Inazuma Companion cards. It also used all available energy, though no effect of unspent energy is stated.
q4_different_intent: No. Based only on the printed information, the three 1-cost cards provide the best known damage and the only block, and a different telegraphed intent would not make the random transformation from Watatsumi Levy a reliable alternative.
